title: A local solution of Ericksen's problem
description:
The manuscript proves the local completeness of the six classical families of orientation preserving C3 universal deformations of homogeneous incompressible isotropic hyperelastic solids. For three distinct constant principal stretches, the principal step establishes local integrability of the plane field orthogonal to one principal direction.

The archive includes the article with appendices and supplementary calculations, complete LaTeX sources, and the SageMath programs, coefficient inputs and exact outputs for ranks zero, one, two and three. The fixed calculation environment uses SageMath 10.9, Python 3.12.14 and SymPy 1.14.0.
